verdict.rationale: Otter's own docs state it can record meetings directly from the Mac or Windows desktop app without a bot joining the call. It also captures Google Meet calls without a bot present, which directly delivers device-side, bot-free capture and transcription. Community complaints about the bot unexpectedly joining calls and default transcript sharing concern the bot-based notetaker mode, not the desktop bot-free mode, so they do not contradict this capability. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that desktop bot-free capture works as claimed, and documentation that external participants receive no notification or auto-shared summary email when recording from the device.

support.subject: As a founder, I can capture and transcribe meetings without a visible bot joining the call — audio is captured from my device so external participants see nothing extra

citations.quote: Record conversations directly from your Mac or Windows desktop, without bots joining the call.
Record bot-free and manage meetings directly through the Otter desktop app
Capture impromptu Google Meet calls without a bot present
Live transcription in multiple languages, and speaker recognition.
